defs.def: the activities that are done in order to plan, organize and run a business, school or other institution （企业、学校等的）管理，行政

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证失效或损坏，或者你更改了个人或课程信息，你应到学生事务中心（SAC）申请补办。

ex.s: In addition to participation in school, a part-time job – such as working in a café or in an office administration role – can also be helpful in this transition.
ex.t: 除了在校参与活动外，一份兼职工作——如在咖啡馆工作或担任办公室行政职务——也可以在这种过渡中有所帮助。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: 曼说，Terrafugia得益于联邦航空管理局五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

defs.def: the process or act of organizing the way that sth is done 施行；执行
the people who plan, organize and run a business, an institution, etc. （企业、学校等的）管理部门，行政部门
the government of a country, especially the US （尤指美国）政府
the act of giving a drug to sb （药物的）施用
a situation in which the financial affairs of a business that cannot pay its debts are managed by an independent administrator 行政接管（公司破产时由独立管理人负责其运营）

ex.s: Run by the China National Space Administration, China's space agency, it comprises three stages: orbiting, landing and returning.
ex.t: 它由中国的国家航天局（CNSA）运营，分为轨道、着陆和返回三个阶段。
